name: The Ritz-Carlton, Fukuoka
positioning: Downtown Fukuoka hotel in the main tower of the Fukuoka Daimyo Garden City complex, with views across Hakata Bay and design that draws on local crafts
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown base a five-minute walk from Tenjin Station
Guests who like local Kyushu cuisine and Fukuoka craft traditions

facts.text: The hotel has views across Hakata Bay.
The hotel is in the main tower of the Fukuoka Daimyo Garden City complex, in downtown Fukuoka.
The hotel is a five-minute walk from the subway at Tenjin Station.
The hotel is Marriott International's first luxury property in Kyushu.
The rooms' finishes and artworks draw on local traditions including woven bamboo and Hakata-ori silks.
The Ritz-Carlton Suite has its own kitchen and a dining room that seats eight.
Genjyu serves kaiseki, sushi and teppan-yaki on Arita or Karatsu porcelain.
Viridis serves farm-to-sky Western cuisine made with local ingredients.
The Bay Bar is on the 24th floor and has an open-air terrace with views of Hakata Bay.
The Ritz-Carlton Spa is on the 24th floor and offers ESPA facials.
Guests can make a stamp book from Hakata-ori silk remnants for shrine and temple visits.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
Guests must be 16 or older to use the spa heat experiences, relaxation areas and treatments.
WhataHotel notes the atmosphere is formal and may not suit all travelers.
